policy: Pins are immutable commit SHAs plus SHA256. Nothing is downloaded by this toolkit; operators supply a local copy that is hash-verified before any command is emitted.

backends.support: Upstream states the script is a utility; treat as unsupported for production unless the owner accepts that risk.
behaviours: Requires Az.Compute 9, Az.Accounts 4 and Az.Resources 7 and an interactive Connect-AzAccount context.
Stops/deallocates the VM, updates OS disk supportedCapabilities, resizes with a direct ARM call and optionally starts it.
Contacts the main branch version.json for a version notice only; it is not executed.

With -FixOperatingSystemSettings it also runs guest changes: Linux initramfs/dracut driver staging and an fstab device-name to UUID rewrite (backup /etc/fstab.bak); Windows StartOverride/registry changes.
Rejects Azure Disk Encryption for Linux and Gen1 images; SKU, Windows-version, module and OS-readiness checks can be skipped only with Ignore switches, which this toolkit forbids.

guestChanges: stornvme Start=0 and StartOverride removal on all ControlSets
backends.caveat: Upstream notes each SCSI boot can recreate StartOverride, so deallocate immediately after preparation. Review the script yourself; this toolkit only references it and does not execute it.

provides: udev NVMe io_timeout=240s for remote Azure NVMe devices (v0.7.0)
backends.installation: Pinned source is review-only, never automatically built or executed. Native preparation separately permits exact Ubuntu archive package versions listed in preparation.json; other channels remain manual. Source packaging exists upstream for Debian, Fedora, Azure Linux/Mariner; their package-channel availability is not asserted here.
backends.limits: Provides device identification and symlinks only. It does not replace NVMe boot-driver staging or stable mount verification.

backends.reason: The entry point is mutable and never blindly downloaded. Native preparation separately supports operator-supplied artifacts bound to SHA256, validated Microsoft Authenticode signatures and the exact MANA PCI identity; see preparation.json.
operatorChecks: Download from the Microsoft entry point on a trusted host
Verify Authenticode signature of every .sys/.cat/.inf catalog with Get-AuthenticodeSignature (Microsoft publisher, status Valid)
Install following the readme in the package; reboot and reassess
Confirm Get-NetAdapter shows Microsoft Azure Network Adapter and counters increment
